newsitem.title: USA: Princeton Dental retains NASDAQ listing.
newsitem.headline: Princeton Dental retains NASDAQ listing.

text.p: Princeton Dental Management Corp said Monday its common stock and warrants will continue to be listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market via an exception from the capital and surplus and minimum bid requirements.

Princeton Dental said it failed to meet this requirement as of April 15, 1997, but was granted a temporary exception from this standard subject to Princeton Dental meeting certain conditions. The exception will expire on September 1, 1997.
If the company meets terms of the exception, it will continue to be listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
Princetom Dental said it believes it can meet these conditions. But it added there can be no assurance that it will do so.
